geeklist.title: Europe based auction - Shipping from Portugal - Very few games
geeklist.description:
[b][size=18]Auction Rules (Read carefully before bidding)[/size][/b] 1. The auction is going to end on Sunday, November 2nd at 22:00 (GMT / UTC +0). 2. Increments must always be in whole numbers, in euros; 3. To avoid sniping, if there is a bid in the last 30 minutes of each item, the deadline is extended by another 30 minutes, until 30 minutes have passed with no bids.
[b][size=18]Shipping:[/size][/b] - In hand: Lisbon. Preferebely on weekends - DHL or CTT to europe , costs depend on size and destination feel free to send me a PM to know for a specific game -> https://enviar.pt.parcel.dhl.com/shipping feel free to check it yourself
[b][size=18]Payment (done within 48h after auction is finished):[/size] [/b]- Paypal (F&F or all fees on you) - MBWay (in Portugal) - Revolut - Or cash in hand delivery
Please pm me for any questions
geeklist.comment: 5h left, no bids in a lot of games :)
